title: The Twilight Zone
overview: A groundbreaking series by Rod Serling, this half-hour anthology featured tales of the strange, the macabre, and the unusual. Some were science fiction, some were supernatural, and some defied easy categorization.This five-season series is best known for its twist endings. Many of the stories were written by Serling himself, others were crafted by Richard Matheson, Charles Beaumont, Earl Hammer Jr. and Ray Bradbury.

Later, as he travels home, Williams decides to get off the next time the train makes its stop at Willoughby – only to jump off the rear of the train and is ultimately put into the back of a hearse owned by a funeral parlor called Willoughby & Son.

It is at this time that the young woman comes to the realization that she is one of the store mannequins, who had the opportunity to live life as a real person for a month.

episodes.title: King Nine Will Not Return
episodes.overview: The pilot of a World War 2 Bomber called King Nine crashes in an African desert, wondering when and where he is. The Captain soon regains consciousness, he starts searching his surroundings and soon finds the graves of his crew and eventually wakes up in a hospital bed, 17 years after the crash. As the psychiatrist assures the nurse that the Captain is only reliving what happened in his mind, she begins to wonder, especially after finding sand in his shoes.

episodes.title: The Man in the Bottle
episodes.overview: A poor pawnbroker inadvertently releases a genie from an old bottle, and is granted three wishes. However, the pawnbroker soon discovers that all wishes have a price.

episodes.title: Nervous Man in a Four Dollar Room
episodes.overview: A nervous little hustler, Jackie Rhoades, is ordered to make a hit on someone for a mobster. However, when he tries to leave his hotel room, he discovers that he first must conquer his ultimate enemy: the face in the mirror.

episodes.title: A Thing About Machines
episodes.overview: A writer (Richard Haydn) believes machines are conspiring against him.

episodes.title: The Howling Man
episodes.overview: David Ellington comes upon an old monastery occupied by a 'Truth' order that is holding a benign old man prisoner.

episodes.title: The Eye of the Beholder
episodes.overview: In a not too distant future, a young woman hopes that plastic surgery will help her look "normal," after living her life as an unattractive freak.

episodes.title: Nick of Time
episodes.overview: A couple on their way to New York City for the husband's new job are unexpectedly waylaid... by a fortune-telling machine in a diner.

episodes.title: The Lateness of the Hour
episodes.overview: When the daughter of an inventor tires of the family's household staff being made up of only robots, she soon discovers a shocking secret that her father and mother have kept from her for years.

episodes.title: The Trouble with Templeton
episodes.overview: A Broadway actor (Brian Aherne) yearning for the days when his wife (Pippa Scott) was alive gets his wish.

episodes.title: A Most Unusual Camera
episodes.overview: A thieving couple (Fred Clark, Jean Carson) discover that a camera that they have stolen takes pictures of the future.

episodes.title: The Night of the Meek
episodes.overview: A drunk department store Santa wishes that he could give presents to everyone... and gets his wish.

episodes.title: Dust
episodes.overview: In the Old West, the desperate father (Vladimir Sokoloff) of a condemned man (John A. Alonzo) buys "magic dust" from a peddler (Thomas Gomez) to save his son.

episodes.title: Back There
episodes.overview: At a meeting in a Washington, D.C. club, several professors hold a discussion on whether it's possible to travel back in time to alter history. One of the men, feeling somewhat faint on his way home, soon finds himself travelled back to the night of Lincoln's assassination. Thinking back to his discussion, he soon decides to try and warn the President, only to be arrested for disturbing the peace. He then realizes that some past events can be changed; others can't.

episodes.title: The Whole Truth
episodes.overview: A used-car dealer (Jack Carson) is forced to tell the truth after buying a car from an old man (George Chandler) who says it is haunted.

episodes.title: The Invaders
episodes.overview: After investigating a loud noise outside of her farmhouse, an elderly woman soon gets terrorized by what appears to be aliens that arrived in a small UFO. However, it turns out that the invaders happen to be astronauts that have been stranded on a planet with giant humanoid people.

episodes.title: A Penny for Your Thoughts
episodes.overview: When a coin lands on its edge, a bank clerk gains the ability to hear other people's thoughts--and soon learns that he can't always believe what he hears.

episodes.title: Twenty-Two
episodes.overview: After being admitted into the hospital for nervous fatigue and being overworked, a dancer by the name of Liz Powell has a hard time resting because of a recurring dream of being led to the hospital morgue. It is only after she gets released and arrives at the airport, about to fly to Miami for a job, does she realize what her dream really meant.

episodes.title: The Odyssey of Flight 33
episodes.overview: On a transatlantic flight to New York City, a pilot and his crew discover that they broke the sound barrier and as a result, travel back in time. Running low on fuel, they try their best to repeat their feat in order to return to the correct year and land.

episodes.title: Mr. Dingle, the Strong
episodes.overview: A hapless vacuum cleaner salesman is given super-strength by a Martian as a means of testing humanity.

episodes.title: Static
episodes.overview: A radio allows an old man (Dean Jagger) to listen to programs from his past.

episodes.title: The Prime Mover
episodes.overview: When a small-time gambler named Ace discovers that his friend has the power of telekinesis following an accident, he decides to exploit those powers so he can become a millionaire in Las Vegas. However, when Jimbo starts experiencing headaches after continually helping his friend win his jackpots, he decides to teach Ace a lesson.

episodes.title: Long Distance Call
episodes.overview: A boy (Bill Mumy) talks with his dead grandmother (Lili Darvas) on the toy telephone she gave him before she died.

episodes.title: A Hundred Yards Over the Rim
episodes.overview: A pioneer who's leading a wagon train to California soon finds himself in 1961 after he goes searching for medical help for his ill son. While in the modern day, the pioneer soon discovers that his son's destiny is to become a doctor and help others.

episodes.title: The Rip Van Winkle Caper
episodes.overview: After successfully robbing a gold shipment, the band of thieves and their scientist ringleader decides to hide in a cave in the desert in suspended animation until the law is no longer looking for them. However, after they awaken from their chambers, the thieves soon discover that their rich, bright future is more than a bit tarnished.

episodes.title: The Silence
episodes.overview: One night at a men's club, respected Colonel Archie Taylor grows tired of the constant chatter of fellow member Jamie Tennyson. As a result, Taylor offers Tennyson a wager: stay silent for one year and be paid $500,000 while living in a glass enclosed cell inside the men's club. However, after the wager is accepted, both men go to drastic measures to win.

episodes.title: Shadow Play
episodes.overview: A man convicted of murder and awaiting execution insists that everything happening is just his nightmare... and he has it every night.

episodes.title: The Mind and the Matter
episodes.overview: A man uses the power of concentration to remake the world in his image.

episodes.title: Will the Real Martian Please Stand Up
episodes.overview: When a pair of state troopers receive a call that an alien spaceship crashed in the woods near a roadside diner in the middle of a snowstorm, they have to try and figure out if one of the snowed-in bus travelers at the diner is not who he claims.

episodes.title: The Obsolete Man
episodes.overview: In a near-future fascist state, librarian Romney Wordsworth is declared obsolete and allowed to pick the method of his own execution.

episodes.title: Two
episodes.overview: Two soldiers from opposing sides cross paths in a city demolished by a devastating war that occurred years before. While they approach one another with suspicion and some hostility, they soon realize they need one another to survive.

episodes.title: The Arrival
episodes.overview: An FAA inspector (Harold J. Stone) and members of the airport staff (Noah Keen, Fredd Wayne, Robert Karnes, and Bing Russell) investigate a plane that arrives without a single person onboard – and each sees it differently.

episodes.title: The Shelter
episodes.overview: When a suburban dinner party is interrupted by an announcement that a nuclear attack on the U.S. is imminent, the party goers scramble home to try and find a way to survive. However, when several families discover that their neighbor, Dr. Stockton has built a bomb shelter for just such an occasion, everyone turns against one another in an attempt to be invited inside the shelter. Will things be able to return to normal if warning turns out to be false?

episodes.title: The Passersby
episodes.overview: While traveling down an apparently deserted road, toward the end of the Civil War, a wounded Confederate Soldier stops to take a rest on the steps of a destroyed mansion. While there, he meets a widow of a Confederate Officer. They soon watch as soldiers, from the North and South, travel down the road, and ultimately realize that at the end of the road is the Promised Land.

episodes.title: A Game of Pool
episodes.overview: A legendary pool player (Jonathan Winters) returns from the dead to meet the challenge of a pool shark (Jack Klugman) with the shark's life at stake.

episodes.title: The Mirror
episodes.overview: In Central America, a mirror allows a dictator (Peter Falk) to see the faces of his enemies.

episodes.title: The Grave
episodes.overview: When the outlaw Pinto Sykes is gunned downed after being ambushed by the men in his hometown, Pinto vows revenge on the gun-for-hire that the men sent after him. When Conny Miller, the man hired to bring Sykes to justice arrives in town following the ambush, he is told of Sykes deathbed vow: if Miller ever comes near his grave, he'll reach up and have his revenge. Thinking that Miller was scared of Sykes, the men of town bet him to go to his grave, and soon discover that vengeance, even from beyond the grave, is a powerful thing.

episodes.title: It's a Good Life
episodes.overview: A six-year-old boy terrorizes the residents of Peaksville, Ohio, with special powers that control reality.

episodes.title: Deaths-Head Revisited
episodes.overview: A former Nazi SS Captain arrives in a small Bavarian town, looking to visit Dachau, an old Concentration camp, wanting to remember what it was like during the war. However, the ghosts of the men he put to death soon arrive, looking to put him on trial for the part he played in their deaths and other crimes against humanity.

episodes.title: The Midnight Sun
episodes.overview: The earth gets thrown off its orbit, and as a result, is getting pulled closer to the sun. Unable to leave their apartment building to find a cooler place to live, two women attempt to acclimate to their new living conditions. However, it soon appears to be nothing but a bad dream of one of the women, as they live on a freezing earth that is being pulled away from the sun.

episodes.title: Still Valley
episodes.overview: During the Civil War, a Confederate scout (Gary Merrill) enters a town to find Yankee soldiers frozen in place.

episodes.title: The Jungle
episodes.overview: An engineer in Africa returns to the States... and a tribesman's curse follows him.

episodes.title: Once Upon a Time
episodes.overview: A janitor (Buster Keaton) travels from 1890 to 1962, courtesy of a time helmet.

episodes.title: Five Characters in Search of an Exit
episodes.overview: Five individuals--a major, a clown, a ballerina, a hobo, and a piper--find themselves trapped in a metal cylinder with no memory of how they came there or their past lives... and no apparent hope of a future.

episodes.title: A Quality of Mercy
episodes.overview: During World War II, a gung-ho young American lieutenant is forced to see the enemy's side of the battlefield... whether he wants to or not.

episodes.title: Nothing in the Dark
episodes.overview: An elderly woman living in a condemned building is scared of leaving her home and finding a new place to live, because she fears that "Mr. Death" is out to kill her. When she finds a wounded young police officer outside her door, she is uncertain if she should help him, fearing that if she does, it would lead to her death.

episodes.title: One More Pallbearer
episodes.overview: A wealthy man sets out to get revenge on three people that he thinks have wronged him... by convincing them that he's the only one who can protect them from a coming nuclear war.

episodes.title: Dead Man's Shoes
episodes.overview: A homeless man (Warren Stevens) literally walks into another life when he steals the shoes from a corpse.

episodes.title: The Hunt
episodes.overview: An old man and his hound dog drown while out raccoon and soon begin trying to find out where they belong in the afterlife. When the first place they come to along the road appears too good to be true, old Hyder Simpson is ready to walk through the gate. However, when he discovers that his dog won't be allowed to join him, he soon has second thoughts and eventually continues on down the road to the Promised Land.

episodes.title: Showdown with Rance McGrew
episodes.overview: The egotistic star (Larry Blyden) of a western TV series comes face to face with the real Jesse James (Arch Johnson).

episodes.title: Kick the Can
episodes.overview: The dispirited residents of a nursing home are urged by one of their number to believe that they can recapture their youth by playing a children's game.Note: Steven Spielberg remade this as Segment II of Twilight Zone: The Movie, showing the nursing-home residents being offered a second chance at youth by their new arrival, Mr. Bloom (Scatman Crothers).

episodes.title: A Piano in the House
episodes.overview: Sadistic and hated theater critic Fitzgerald Fortune buys a player piano that has the power to reveal the souls of all who hear it.

episodes.title: The Last Rites of Jeff Myrtlebank
episodes.overview: As family and friends sit through the funeral of Jeff Myrtlebank, they are in for a rude awakening when he sits up from his coffin, demanding to know what's going on. They then begin to fear Jeff came back to life, possessed by a demon and soon bow to his will for fear of what might happen to their crops and loved ones.

episodes.title: To Serve Man
episodes.overview: An alien race, the Kanamits, come to Earth providing technology and guidance to turn the planet into a utopia. But one man questions their benevolence.

episodes.title: The Fugitive
episodes.overview: A fugitive (J. Pat O'Malley) from another world befriends a handicapped girl (Susan Gordon).

episodes.title: Little Girl Lost
episodes.overview: When parents Chris and Ruth Miller wake up in the middle of the night to the cries of their daughter Tina, they are shocked to discover that she somehow fell through the wall of her bedroom into another dimension. They then call Chris' physicist friend Bill for help in rescuing Tina before the portal she fell through closes for good.

episodes.title: Person or Persons Unknown
episodes.overview: David Allen Gurney wakes up on morning and discovers that no one knows who he is and that he doesn't exist in the new world that he finds himself in.

episodes.title: The Little People
episodes.overview: When two astronauts (Claude Akins, Joe Maross) land on a distant planet, one of them becomes a "God" to a race of tiny people.

episodes.title: Four O'Clock
episodes.overview: A fanatical one-man moral crusader (Theodore Bikel) decides to shrink those he deems evil to a height of two feet at four o'clock.

episodes.title: Hocus-Pocus and Frisby
episodes.overview: A rural gas station attendant given to telling tall tales about himself is kidnapped by aliens who believe him to be one of Earth's leading intellects.

episodes.title: The Trade-Ins
episodes.overview: An elderly couple look to trade-in their aging bodies for younger models. However, they only have enough money for one to go through the process, and the husband decides to go through it and then earn the money for his wife. However, upon going through with it, he realizes he made a mistake.

episodes.title: The Gift
episodes.overview: A visitor from outer space (Geoffrey Horne) tries to present a gift to a Mexican village that greets him only with suspicion.

episodes.title: The Dummy
episodes.overview: A ventriloquist (Cliff Robertson) believes his dummy is alive ... and is beginning to take over not just the act.

episodes.title: Young Man's Fancy
episodes.overview: Upon a newlywed's arrival to his boyhood home with his bride, he starts to have reservations selling the place following his mother's death. However, it doesn't take long for the home to have a magical effect on the couple: time has turned back to when the overbearing mother is back alive and the bridegroom is back living as a little boy, who promptly tells his bride to go away.

episodes.title: I Sing the Body Electric
episodes.overview: A recent widower, needing loving care for his three young children, orders a cybernetic "grandmother". While two of the children accept her, one of his daughters fiercely rejects her, with near tragic consequences.

episodes.title: Cavender is Coming
episodes.overview: Inept guardian angel Harmon Cavender is given a chance to earn his wings by helping an unconventional big city woman, the young, awkward Agnes Grep.

episodes.title: The Changing of the Guard
episodes.overview: An elderly boys school teacher faces mandatory retirement and questions whether he's done anything with his life.

episodes.title: In His Image
episodes.overview: A scientist (George Grizzard) creates a near-perfect mechanical man endowed with all the qualities he feels he is lacking.

episodes.title: The Thirty-Fathom Grave
episodes.overview: When a US Naval destroyer picks up the signal of US submarine that was sunk 20 years prior, one of the sailors begins to feel like he doesn't belong with the crew on the ship.

episodes.title: Valley of the Shadow
episodes.overview: While on his way back to the big city, a reporter by the name of Phillip Redfield gets lost on a series of backroads and finds his way into a small town called Paradise Valley, New Mexico. However, during his brief stay there, Redfield observes lots of spectacular events that he soon discovers occur due to advanced technology from another planet. When he informs the town elders that he plans on telling their story in his newspaper when he arrives back home, they decide to hold him prisoner. It soon doesn't take long for the town elders to reverse their decision.

episodes.title: He's Alive
episodes.overview: A power-hungry American Nazi (Dennis Hopper) receives advice from a mysterious benefactor. With Paul Mazursky.

episodes.title: Mute
episodes.overview: Following the death of her parents in a fire that also destroyed her home, a young girl struggles to interact with those that expect her to verbally speak, due to the fact that her parents were part of a secret society where people communicated through telekinetic powers and never taught her how to talk.

episodes.title: Death Ship
episodes.overview: Three astronauts (Jack Klugman, Ross Martin, and Fred Beir) discover exact duplicates of their spaceship and themselves that crashed on a distant planet.

episodes.title: Jess-Belle
episodes.overview: A mountain girl (Anne Francis) enlists a witch (Jeanette Nolan) to help her win back her lover (James Best).

episodes.title: Miniature
episodes.overview: A timid misfit finds love and happiness at a museum when he discovers a miniature doll comes to life to only him. As a result, he tries to find a way to spend all his time with her.

episodes.title: Printer's Devil
episodes.overview: A newspaper owner on the brink of suicide gets a second chance from a mysterious man named Smith... who gives him a printer that foretells the news.

episodes.title: No Time Like the Past
episodes.overview: A scientist (Dana Andrews) goes back in time to try and change history.

episodes.title: The Parallel
episodes.overview: An astronaut (Steve Forrest) returns from a space flight to find things much changed during his absence.

episodes.title: I Dream of Genie
episodes.overview: An office worker (Howard Morris) acquires a lamp with a genie (Jack Albertson) who offers him a wish.

episodes.title: The New Exhibit
episodes.overview: After learning that the wax museum that he works in will be closing down effective immediately, employee Martin Lombard Senescu frantically convinces his boss to let him store the wax figures in his "Murderers Row" exhibit until a buyer is found. However, it doesn't take long for Martin to become convinced that they're capable of killing again, and when a buyer is found, a new wax figure is added to the mix.

episodes.title: Of Late I Think of Cliffordville
episodes.overview: Aging, wealthy tycoon William Feathersmith is getting bored with his life. After meeting with his old business partner Mr. Deidrich, Feathersmith decides to find a way to relive his life again. As a result, he makes an arrangement with a devilish travel agency to go back in time. However, it doesn't take long that making a deal with the devil doesn't always go as planned.

episodes.title: The Incredible World of Horace Ford
episodes.overview: A middle-aged toy designer (Pat Hingle) goes back to his childhood when he visits his old neighborhood.

episodes.title: On Thursday We Leave for Home
episodes.overview: The first human space colony is about to be rescued from the forsaken planet they've been on for three decades. But their leader's having a hard time accepting that change will happen when they get back to Earth.

episodes.title: Passage on the Lady Anne
episodes.overview: A woman hopes a trans-Atlantic cruise and holiday in London will help save her marriage, unaware that the ship is on a final voyage into the afterlife.

episodes.title: The Bard
episodes.overview: A bumbling screenwriter, Julius K. Moomer, is becoming desperate for a sale after 23 years working on unproduced scripts. When his agent mentions that he is submitting another writer's pitch for a television series about black magic, Julius pleads to be allowed to be given first crack at the series. Knowing nothing about the subject, he attempts some research but turns up only an actual book of black magic. While experimenting with the book he accidentally conjures William Shakespeare, who says he is at the service of the conjurer. Deciding not to waste Shakespeare's talent on a television pilot, Julius directs him to write a film.

episodes.title: Promo: Black Leather Jackets
episodes.overview: A trio of aliens, dressed as "hoodlums" in black leather jackets, arrive in a small town, look to eradicate all life on Earth so their kind can expand on a new planet. However, one of the aliens falls in love with a local girl and is hesitant to go along with his friends' plans and ultimately tries to talk her into leaving town with him.

episodes.overview: David Allen Gurney wakes up on morning and discovers that no one knows who he is and that he doesn't exist in the new world that he finds himself in.

episodes.title: Promo: The Silence
episodes.overview: One night at a men's club, respected Colonel Archie Taylor grows tired of the constant chatter of fellow member Jamie Tennyson. As a result, Taylor offers Tennyson a wager: stay silent for one year and be paid $500,000 while living in a glass enclosed cell inside the men's club. However, after the wager is accepted, both men go to drastic measures to win.
